title: Return to Sender
writing_pass: Open on the impossible delivery status and immediately state the contradiction.
Give the courier a relatable goal: her final stop before home.
Replace the narrator's obvious speed commentary with the courier's question and cancellation attempt.
Explain why descending below the lobby is dangerous instead of reading the display aloud.
Introduce an expected recipient, preserving ambiguity about what was actually ordered.
Make the refusal and the figure's answer a direct exchange; preserve the final reversal.
